description: Check realtime availability of a specific wig or hairpiece at MyHairMail by brand, style, and color. Availability reflects live factory-feed data, not a nightly sync. Returns stock status, price, and a purchase link. One product per call (or up to 12 colors if color omitted). Terms: https://mcp.myhairmailtools.com/terms

brand.description: Brand name, e.g. 'Jon Renau', 'Raquel Welch', 'Belle Tress'

color.description: Color code or name, e.g. '12FS8' or 'Shaded Praline'. Optional; if omitted, returns per-color availability for up to 12 colors.

name: check_stock
